description: Text chart customization: every non-default property here is one eas draws natively (fc-qx1.43).

eas.note: eas-oes: bin/chart drew the reference in MS Courier New. The check measures against TeX Gyre Cursor, Courier's metrics and shapes, which the oracle's fonts.conf (scripts/eas-spikes/vega-oracle) maps Courier New to: ratio 0.0115 on rsvg-convert 2.60. With Liberation Mono it is 0.0245; unmapped, with whatever face fontconfig falls back to, 0.0646.
